rationale: Create Freedom Alternative Fuel Infrastructure as the canonical current platform for the historical Freedom CNG holding. Record Apollo Global Management-managed funds' completed majority acquisition on September 12, 2024, retain exact stake percentage and fund as not publicly disclosed, and add verified identity, North American operating profile, ownership, platform milestones and direct primary citations. Treat X3CNG, Lancer Energy and ComTech Energy as integrated bolt-ons rather than separate portfolio companies.

afterImage.subsector: Compressed and renewable natural gas fueling infrastructure
afterImage.description: Freedom Alternative Fuel Infrastructure, branded Freedom AFI and formerly known as Freedom CNG, designs, builds, owns and operates fixed and mobile compressed-natural-gas and renewable-natural-gas fueling infrastructure across the United States and Canada. The Houston-headquartered platform serves fleets including logistics and transportation operators, refuse companies, municipalities and school districts. Founded in 2012, Freedom expanded its Western U.S. network through the 2025 acquisitions of X3CNG and Lancer Energy and added Canadian capabilities through ComTech Energy. Apollo Global Management-managed funds acquired a majority interest in September 2024; the exact ownership percentage and specific fund are not publicly disclosed. Current company and Apollo materials continued to show Apollo majority ownership and Infrastructure Group board representation, and no Apollo exit was identified through August 8, 2026.
